description_en: Modifies the binding information of a landline AXN private number
description_zh: 修改固话AXN隐私号码绑定信息
kebab_example: aliyun dyplsapi update-axn-bind-fixed-line --app-id FC100000168480000 --ts 20161114143116123 --order-id 1230000000 --subts 20161114143116 --sub-id GHX00000000000000000000000000 --tela '手机号：18200002371_固话：057100000036' --telb 15500002222 --anucode 1,2,3 --anucodecalled 1,2 --t-anucode-connect 1,2 --expiration 60 --remark 19394 --extra Callback=0 Callrecording=1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateAxnBindFixedLine

parameters.help_en: The business timestamp. Format: yyyyMMddHHmmssSSS. The time is in UTC+8, in 24-hour format, accurate to milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 业务时间戳，格式：yyyyMMddHHmmssSSS，时间采用北京时间，24小时制，精确至毫秒
parameters.name: ts

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the message request
parameters.name: order_id

parameters.help_en: The binding time. Format: yyyyMMddHHmmss. The time is in UTC+8, in 24-hour format
parameters.help_zh: 绑定时间，格式为yyyyMMddHHmmss。时间采用北京时间，24小时制
parameters.name: subts

parameters.help_en:
The A number of the landline AXN private number.

> The A number can be a mobile phone number or a landline number. A landline number must include the area code. Do not add a hyphen between the area code and the number
parameters.help_zh:
固话AXN隐私号的A号码。

> A号码可设置为手机号码或固定电话，固定电话需要加区号，区号和号码中间不需要加连字符
parameters.name: tela

parameters.help_en: The N number of the landline AXN private number
parameters.name: telb

parameters.help_en:
The caller-side ringback tone codes. This parameter is required for AXB services. The codes must include three scenarios. Enter the codes in the order of "B->X, A->X, other numbers->X", separated by commas.

> "1,2,3" indicates that the ringback tone code for B->X is 1, for A->X is 2, and for other numbers->X is 3
parameters.help_zh:
主叫侧放音编码，AXB业务时必须设置。必须包含3个场景的编码。按照“B->X,A->X,其他号码->X”的顺序填写编码，编码之间以逗号分隔。

> “1,2,3”表示B->X放音编号为1，A->X放音编号为2，其他号码->X放音编号为3
parameters.name: anucode

parameters.help_en:
The callee-side ringback tone codes played after the call is connected. The codes must include two scenarios. Enter the codes in the order of "A as callee, B as callee", separated by commas.

> "1,2" indicates that the ringback tone code when A is the callee is 1, and the code when B is the callee is 2
parameters.help_zh:
接通后被叫侧放音编码，必须包含2个场景的编码。按照“A被叫,B被叫”的顺序填写编码，编码之间以逗号分隔。

> “1,2”表示A号码为被叫侧接听时的放音编号为1，B号码为被叫侧接听时的放音编号为2
parameters.name: anucodecalled

parameters.help_en:
The caller-side ringback tone codes played after the call is connected. The codes must include two scenarios. Enter the codes in the order of "A as callee, B as callee", separated by commas.

> "1,2" indicates that the caller-side ringback tone code when A is the callee is 1, and the code when B is the callee is 2
parameters.help_zh:
接通后主叫侧的放音编码，必须包含2个场景的编码。按照“A被叫,B被叫”的顺序填写编码，编码之间以逗号分隔。

> “1,2”表示A号码为被叫时主叫侧的放音编号为1，B号码为被叫时主叫侧的放音编号为2
parameters.name: t_anucode_connect

parameters.help_en:
The expiration time. Unit: seconds. Valid values:

- 0: never expires.

- Other values: specifies the validity period. For example, if you set this parameter to 60, the binding remains valid for 60 seconds after the X number is successfully assigned. After 60 seconds, the binding is automatically released
parameters.help_zh:
过期时间，单位：秒，取值：

- 0：永不过期。

- 其他数值：传其它数值时，比如60s，分配X号码成功的60秒内，绑定有效，超过60s后，自动解绑
parameters.name: expiration

parameters.help_en: An external business extension field. This parameter is returned in the call record receipt message. The value cannot exceed 100 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 外部业务扩展字段，通话记录回执消息中会回传此参数。不能超过100个字符长度
parameters.name: remark

fields.help_en:
The callback control. A calls through X, meaning A is the caller and X is the called number. Valid values:

- 0 (default): outbound calls are not allowed.

- 1: connects to the most recent N number.

- 2: calls back the fixed number TelB
fields.help_zh:
回拨控制。A通过X呼叫，即A主叫X。取值：

- 0（默认值）：不能外呼。

- 1：接续最近的N号码。

- 2：回拨固定号码TelB
fields.name: callback

fields.help_en:
The recording control. Valid values:

- 0 (default): recording is disabled.

- 1: recording is enabled.

> After the call recording feature is enabled, you can play and download voice files in the call records. Recording files are billed at 0.010 CNY per minute
fields.help_zh:
录音控制。取值：

- 0（默认值）：不录音。

- 1：录音。

> 开启通话录音功能后，可在呼叫记录中播放和下载语音文件。录音文件按通话分钟计费0.010元/分钟
fields.name: callrecording
